caption: source record SRC-S66. Selected reporting boundaries and evidence locations
rows: P: The title emphasizes profiling. The abstract provides an abbreviated account of design, results and uncertainty.
P/U: Assessor qualifications and blinding are incomplete or undocumented. Coding diagnostics do not constitute a formal cluster-level bias assessment.
P: Available records determine sample size. Primary and seven-field input summaries have broader coverage than auxiliary inputs and individual-airport distributions.
P: Comprehensive national per-airport loss intervals, formal fairness assessment and usability evaluation remain outside the reported evidence.
R/P: No ethics approval or institutional exemption determination was obtained. The study was not preregistered and had no airport-personnel or public design involvement.
P: The current data and code archives are unpublished. Recorded replay excludes a fresh extraction of every national airport and a clean installation test.
note: Main-text link: Section 3.7, use of TRIPOD-Cluster and TRIPOD+AI to distinguish analytical roles. Combined status labels describe the selected items, not a new rating. The selected_item_map.json file lists their identifiers.
